canonicalIngredients.name: chickpeas
observations: 1 cup dried / 200 g or 2.5 cups canned (s2)

canonicalIngredients.name: garam masala
observations: 2 tsp chana masala or garam masala (s3)

canonicalIngredients.name: whole spices (bay leaf, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves)
observations: 1 bay + 1 in cinnamon + 2 cloves + 2 cardamom, optional (s0)
1 bay + 4 cardamom + 3 cloves + 1 in cinnamon + 7 peppercorns (s2)

causalSequence: optional: soak dried chickpeas overnight; pressure cook till squashable (or use canned, drained)
heat oil; sizzle whole spices and cumin seeds till fragrant
add ginger, garlic, green chilli; cook 1 min
add tomato, salt; cook down to thick pulp
stir in ground spices; fry 30 sec-4 min till aromatic, oil separating
add chickpeas, water; cover, simmer 10-25 min till thick
finish with kasuri methi, coriander leaves; lemon juice to taste
techniqueFacts: all four sources temper spices in hot oil before onion; two name blooming as the flavour foundation
two sources cook ground spices into the reduced tomato until oil separates from the masala
three sources accept canned chickpeas as a direct swap for soaked-and-pressure-cooked dried
one source blends the onion-tomato masala for a smooth restaurant-style gravy
end-added tang is standard: lemon juice (3 sources), amchur (1), kasuri methi (3)
one source uses chickpea cooking water as the gravy liquid
vegan: all four cook in plant oil, never ghee; one notes an optional ghee-fried ginger garnish that breaks vegan
dairy appears only at serve time: one source dollops Greek yogurt on the plate; the dish itself is dairy-free
gluten free as cooked; GF serving is rice, naan/roti sides contain wheat
